invariants_created: Every HTTP/1.1 request MUST include a Host header field.
If a request has a body (POST/PUT/PATCH), it MUST include either Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding header.
POST/PUT/PATCH requests with a body SHOULD include a Content-Type header describing the body media type.
HEAD response MUST NOT include a body, even if the equivalent GET would have one.
A 401 Unauthorized response MUST include a WWW-Authenticate header field describing the auth scheme.
3xx redirect responses MUST include a Location header specifying the target URI.
After receiving a 301/302 redirect, the client SHOULD issue a GET request to the Location URI.
After receiving a 401 Unauthorized, the client SHOULD retry the same request with an Authorization header.
Persistent connections (keep-alive) allow multiple request-response cycles on a single TCP connection without reconnecting.
Connection: close header signals that the connection will be closed after the current response.
OPTIONS * is a server-level options request where the request-target is asterisk (*) instead of a path.
A 201 Created response SHOULD include a Location header pointing to the newly created resource.
GET and HEAD are safe methods and MUST NOT have side effects on the server.
PUT and DELETE are idempotent; multiple identical requests have the same effect as a single request.
POST and PATCH are non-idempotent; repeated requests may have different effects.
GET REQUEST.Host: MUST be present in every HTTP/1.1 request
POST REQUEST.Content-Length: MUST be present when body is included (or Transfer-Encoding: chunked)
POST REQUEST.Content-Type: SHOULD be present to describe body media type
PUT REQUEST.Content-Length: MUST be present when body is included (or Transfer-Encoding: chunked)
PUT REQUEST.Content-Type: SHOULD be present to describe body media type
PATCH REQUEST.Content-Length: MUST be present when body is included (or Transfer-Encoding: chunked)
PATCH REQUEST.Content-Type: SHOULD be present to describe body media type
HEAD REQUEST.Body: MUST NOT be present in the response
301 MOVED PERMANENTLY RESPONSE.Location: MUST be present to indicate the new URI
401 UNAUTHORIZED RESPONSE.WWW-Authenticate: MUST be present to indicate authentication scheme and realm
201 CREATED RESPONSE.Location: SHOULD be present to indicate the URI of the created resource
204 NO CONTENT RESPONSE.Body: MUST NOT have a body
GET REQUEST.Body: SHOULD NOT have a body (GET semantics are for retrieval)
DELETE REQUEST.Body: Typically no body is sent
OPTIONS REQUEST.Path: May be '*' for server-level options instead of a resource path
